name: socialrouter
description: SocialRouter's go-to-market playbooks. One plugin per playbook, install only the one you came for.

plugins.name: audience-miner
plugins.description: Turn a competitor's LinkedIn audience into a named prospect list: reads the account's recent posts, collects who commented and reacted, enriches title and company, and ranks everyone in four tiers.

plugins.name: post-finder
plugins.description: Turn a profile URL into that account's recent posts, in full text: picks the right service per platform, batches the profiles, and returns each post with its date, engagement and URL.
